name: Qube Browser 0.3.0
notes:
Added:

* New layout: the page as a card, the address above it
* Collapsible sidebar (Ctrl+B) that floats out from the edge
* Peek: open a link in a floating card over the page
* New Library: History, Downloads, Spaces and Media
* Download card above the Library button
* Two-finger swipe between Spaces
* Set Qube as your default browser
* Idle tabs are archived
* History per Space
* Switch to an open tab from the command bar

Improved:

* Essentials: your Space's colours, smoother, more than one per site
* Drag and drop in every direction, including your first pin
* Closing a tab goes back to the previous one
* Site icons come from the site itself
* Search suggestions: pick a service, off by default
* The command bar opens where you clicked

Fixed:

* Empty page when started from the Start menu
* Sideways scrolling went up and down
* A tab could show up twice

Removed:

* Mac-mode
* Essentials and Archived Tabs in the Library

Known:

* No private browsing yet
* One window only
* Touchpad swipe is untested
* Some extensions, like 1Password, don't work yet
summary: A new layout, Peek, the new Library, and Essentials in your Space's colours.
